final: WITH account_avg AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_avg AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount FROM account_avg GROUP BY frequency) SELECT x.account_id, x.frequency, x.avg_amount, x.avg_amount / NULLIF(f.avg_amount, 0) AS ratio FROM account_avg AS x JOIN frequency_avg AS f ON x.frequency COLLATE BINARY = f.frequency COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
